name: kind
description: purchase, subscription_start, renewal, refund, expire, cancel, uncancel, billing_issue, billing_recovered, product_change, pause, resume, test

name: app_id
description: The build (Android package, iOS bundle, or the build's id)

name: store
description: google, apple, amazon, steam, stripe, xsolla, manual

name: user_id
description: The billing user id the game uses

name: price_micros
description: Gross price in micros of currency (positive also for refunds)

name: proceeds_micros
description: Gross minus the estimated store commission

name: net_micros
description: Gross without the estimated tax, minus the store commission

name: app_instance_id
description: Firebase app_instance_id of the player's device, for joining with the GA4 export

name: attribution_json
description: Device ids the client sent (tenjin_id, appsflyer_id, ...)
